analysis.title: Ovintiv Inc. (OVV): First Take: 3Q26 EBITDA Beat Driven By Strong Operations in Permian; Focus on Pending Bolt-On And Capital
key_insights: OVV reported 3Q26 EBITDA of $1.38 bn vs GS estimate of $1.32 bn and FactSet consensus of $1.33 bn, a beat of about 4% against both.
3Q26 FCF was $680 mn vs GS/consensus estimates of $627/$595 mn. Capex was $563 mn vs GS/consensus of $547/$569 mn.
Oil and condensate production was 204 Mbo/d vs GS estimate of 208 Mbo/d, a 2% miss. Total production of 631 Mboe/d was 1% above GS at 625 Mboe/d.
Net debt rose to $3.4 bn at the end of 3Q26 from $3.0 bn at the end of 2Q26.

4Q26 guidance: oil + condensate of 203-207 Mbo/d vs GS at 209 Mbo/d, total production of 615-640 Mboe/d vs GS/consensus at 622/628 Mboe/d, and capital spending of $550-$600 mn vs GS/consensus at $547/$563 mn.

2026 guidance: oil + condensate range of 210-212 Mbo/d and total production of 630-645 Mboe/d are maintained, capital spending of $2.25-$2.35 bn is maintained, and the liquids range was raised to 295-299 Mbbls/d from 293-297 Mbbls/d.
Realized natural gas price was $2.70/Mcf vs GS at $2.23/Mcf (+21%). Realized liquids price was $63.18/bbl vs GS at $66.25/bbl (-5%).
Total cash costs were $13.83/boe vs GS at $14.49/boe (-5%), helped by production taxes of $1.03/boe vs GS at $1.38/boe.
Adjusted EPS of $1.95 was below GS at $1.98 and consensus at $2.03. Reported EPS was $1.99 vs GS at $1.98.

GS lists five questions for the 10 AM ET call: the Logan Energy transaction and capital competition, Montney condensate pricing in 4Q26, 2027 TIL cadence across Montney and Permian, added Permian locations through ground game additions, and drivers of Permian well results including surfactant solutions.

GS rates OVV Buy with a 12-month price target of $72 against a $66.43 price (8.4% upside). The target uses a 12.0% FCF yield on 2027/2028 estimates, with an M&A rank of 2 weighted 15% into the valuation.

market_movers.rationale: Price target of $72 is unchanged from the 26-Oct-26 raise. It rests on a 12.0% target FCF yield on 2027/2028 estimates, with an 85% fundamental and 15% M&A weighting.
